letters.note: x is at the end of fox

shapes.name: circle
shapes.desc: A circle is round and has no corners, like a ball or a roti.

shapes.name: square
shapes.desc: A square has four sides, all the same size, like a window or a cracker.

shapes.name: triangle
shapes.desc: A triangle has three sides and three corners, like a slice of pizza or a samosa.

shapes.name: rectangle
shapes.desc: A rectangle has four sides, two long and two short, like a door or a book.

shapes.name: star
shapes.desc: A star shape has five points, like the stars we draw in the sky.

shapes.name: heart
shapes.desc: A heart shape means love. We draw it on cards for people we love.

shapes.name: oval
shapes.desc: An oval is like a stretched circle, like an egg.

shapes.name: diamond
shapes.desc: A diamond looks like a square standing on its corner, like a kite.

body_parts.name: mouth
body_parts.use: We eat and talk with our mouth.

body_parts.name: hands
body_parts.use: We hold and clap with our hands.

body_parts.name: legs
body_parts.use: We walk and run with our legs.

body_parts.name: feet
body_parts.use: We stand and jump on our feet.

body_parts.name: teeth
body_parts.use: We chew our food with our teeth.

body_parts.name: tongue
body_parts.use: We taste sweet and sour with our tongue.

body_parts.name: head
body_parts.use: Our head keeps our brain safe, and we think with our brain.
